newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Nord Pacific seeks OK for new listing.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Nord Pacific seeks OK for new listing.

text.p: Nord Pacific Ltd, the Australia-based arm of Nord Resources Corp, said on Thursday it is seeking approval for a public listing in Canada.
A proxy statement has been delivered to shareholders for a meeting to be held on February 17, seeking approval for an underwritten public offering of Nord Pacific stock in Canada, the company said.
Proceeds of the offering would be used for development of the Simberi Island gold project in Papua New Guinea, Nord Pacific said.

Funds would also be used to further exploration work on the Tabar Islands, where Nord Pacific is searching for gold, and to determine the feasibility of its Tritton copper project as well extend exploration in Girilambone area of Australia, where Nord Pacific mines about 6,500 tonnes of copper a year.

Prior to a Canadian offering, Nord Pacific said it would reverse split its common shares trading on the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) with the effect that each new common share will be equivalent to an American depository receipt currently trading on NASDAQ, the company said.
Nord Pacific shares have traded on the ASX since February 1994.
